files.README.md:
# mail-relay

The overnight job hands the day's customer notices to the outbound mail
exchangers. Each line is `<UTC time> <level> <message>`; a batch that reaches
an exchanger is reported as delivered, and a connection that drops is retried
inside the same run. The closing line reports the run's totals.
